nodes.name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Reads INBOX and marks processed mails as read; the trigger cannot move them, a Code node does that at the end of each branch. Attachments are not downloaded — they are never analysed and would only cost memory. Assign the IMAP credential after the import.

nodes.name: Guard: filter, quota, extract
nodes.notes: Subject filter, sender and body extraction, and the daily cost cap (10 system-wide, 3 per sender) in /home/node/.n8n/join-quota-state.json. A mail without the [JOIN] prefix leaves as route=skip before a slot is spent.

nodes.name: Passed the guard?
nodes.notes: route=ok goes to the model; skip, error and quota go to the notice branch.

nodes.name: Issue analysis (AI Agent)
nodes.notes: At most two Gemini calls (maxIterations 2); the shape of the answer is asked for by the Structured Output Parser and checked again in Map AI answer. Errors continue on the error output and end up in the same map node.

nodes.name: Map AI answer
nodes.notes: Checks the model answer again in code — the parser schema is a request to the model, and Firebase rules do not apply to the service account. Unusable output becomes route=error.

nodes.name: Ticket usable?
nodes.notes: route=ok writes the ticket; route=error answers the sender instead.

nodes.name: Fetch task ids
nodes.notes: shallow=true returns the task keys only. Pulling the whole task list on every incoming mail would be a waste — the next id is all this step needs.

nodes.name: Build task payload
nodes.notes: Next id like buildNextTaskId in js/core/data-utils.js, status triage, source email, creator typed extern, and the German AI hint at the front of the description as the Lastenheft asks.

nodes.name: Write ticket
nodes.notes: PUT writes the record complete under the id the previous node picked. The workflow knows every field of a new ticket, so a full write is the honest operation here.

parameters.subject: =[JOIN] Ticket created: {{ $('Build task payload').first().json.title }}

nodes.name: Send confirmation
nodes.notes: Assign the SMTP credential after the import.

nodes.name: Move mail to erledigt
nodes.notes: Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=imap plus JOIN_IMAP_USER and JOIN_IMAP_PASSWORD. A failed move is reported as data, never thrown: the ticket exists, only the mail sits in the wrong folder.

nodes.name: Send failure notice
nodes.notes: The text comes from the notice the map node built. Assign the SMTP credential after the import.

nodes.name: Move mail to zu-bearbeiten (AI error)
nodes.notes: Same code as the other two move nodes, only the target folder differs.

nodes.name: Notify sender?
nodes.notes: route=skip carries an empty notice and ends here: a mail without the [JOIN] prefix gets no reply, is not moved and costs no quota. Without this node every spam mail would be answered.

nodes.name: Send guard notice
nodes.notes: One node for both guard rejections: the daily limit and an unusable mail differ only in the notice text the guard built. Assign the SMTP credential after the import.

nodes.name: Move mail to zu-bearbeiten (guard)
nodes.notes: Same code as the other two move nodes, only the target folder differs.
